name: Valentina Carrasco
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While pursuing a degree in journalism, she landed an internship with a local rally team and quickly discovered a passion for the sport's unique blend of technology, strategy, and raw human skill. After graduating, she honed her skills in media relations, working for several smaller teams before joining Iron Lynx. 

Valentina believes in building strong relationships with the press and public, focusing on authentic storytelling to showcase the human side of racing. She's meticulous in her approach, crafting narratives that highlight both the team's technical prowess and the drivers' dedication. What distinguishes Valentina is her ability to leverage social media trends and combine them with traditional PR methods, creating effective and relevant campaigns.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail when working.
physical.description: Valentina is of average height with an athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during races.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Chilean coffee before any major announcement.
